verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is itself an AI coding agent. Its docs describe handing it a task: it reads the codebase, edits files, compiles, runs tests and sanitizers, and presents a diff for review, with configurable approval policies (docs-1, docs-18, docs-7). Delegation is also documented through `byteask exec`, which runs a task to completion, plus session queueing and an `/agents` command center (docs-19, docs-22, docs-25). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete as described; the evidence is vendor docs plus site-index probes only.
